info.name: KaamGar API
info.description:
Authentication, roles, invitations, workers, bookings and notifications.

Setup: run `npm run setup` in the backend, and put EXPOSE_DEV_LINKS=true in the backend .env (development only) so invitation links are also returned here.
Run the folders in order, or use the Collection Runner. Edit the Variables tab if your host or admin details differ.

item.name: 1. Setup: platform admin invites a cooperative admin
Skills a new worker can choose (public)

exec: pm.test("Only id and name are exposed", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.services.every(s => Object.keys(s).length === 2)).to.eql(true); });

item.name: SHOULD FAIL: invite with a password (platform admin never sets passwords)
Invite a cooperative admin (email with a set-password link)

exec: pm.test('Dev link is present (set EXPOSE_DEV_LINKS=true in the backend .env)', function () { pm.expect(link).to.be.a('string'); });

item.description: Postman keeps ONE refresh cookie per host. These requests are ordered so the cookie always belongs to the right person.

item.name: 5. Role matrix (4 roles x 4 protected endpoints)

exec: pm.test("Shows the joined admin with their cooperative", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.admins.some(a => a.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('coopAdminId') && a.invitePending === false && a.cooperativeName)).to.eql(true); });

Send a password-reset link to a cooperative admin

item.name: The reset link sets a new password and signs them in
Workers list (with phone, card, skills, areas)

exec: pm.test("Sees the pending worker's details", function () { pm.expect((function(){const w=pm.response.json().data.workers.find(x=>x.id===pm.collectionVariables.get('workerId')); return w && w.status==='pending' && w.phone && w.shramikCardNumber && w.skills.length>0 && w.areas.length>0})()).to.eql(true); });

item.name: Cooperative admin was notified about the new worker
SHOULD FAIL: the worker approves themselves
SHOULD FAIL: the other cooperative's admin cannot see this worker (404)
SHOULD FAIL: approve with no skills
Approve the worker (after checking and editing details)

exec: pm.test("Active and Cooperative-reviewed", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.worker.status === 'active' && pm.response.json().data.worker.verified === true && pm.response.json().data.worker.skills.length === 2).to.eql(true); });

item.name: Worker signs in as an approved worker
Worker was notified of the approval
SHOULD FAIL: decline without a reason
Decline the second worker with a reason
The declined worker sees the reason when signing in

exec: pm.test("Reason is shown", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.message.includes('Card photo is unclear')).to.eql(true); });
pm.test("Internal fields hidden", function () { pm.expect(!('evidence' in pm.response.json().data.services[0])).to.eql(true); });

pm.test("Pending with ref and one timeline event", function () { pm.expect((function(){const b=pm.response.json().data.booking; return b.status==='PENDING' && /^KG-\d+$/.test(b.ref) && b.history.length===1})()).to.eql(true); });

pm.test("The approved worker is offered", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.workers.some(w => w.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('workerId'))).to.eql(true); });

Worker was notified of the new job
Worker's jobs (customer phone hidden until accepted)

exec: pm.test("Job listed, no contact", function () { pm.expect((function(){const j=pm.response.json().data.jobs.find(x=>x.id===pm.collectionVariables.get('bookingId')); return j && j.status==='ASSIGNED' && !('contact' in j)})()).to.eql(true); });
pm.test("ACCEPTED, phone now visible", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.job.status === 'ACCEPTED' && pm.response.json().data.job.contact === '9876543210').to.eql(true); });

item.name: Customer was told the work is complete
